narrative.overview: Structured Book Shelf behaves like a private scholarly press whose books expose the source structure beneath their covers. The system is editorial first and refined second: full fields of color, asymmetrical reading space, narrow measures, exact hairlines, and large authored book objects create presence without turning the archive into a store or theatrical 3D demo. Motion has one ceremonial opening and then settles into weighted reading; provenance never disappears behind atmosphere.
keyCharacteristics: Full-field editorial chapters rather than card stacks.
One Mincho reading register against one evidentiary Gothic sans register.
Square geometry, hairline division, and deliberately empty space.
Authored book objects as proof—not generic imagery or copied jackets.
Source paths, epistemic labels, and archive facts visible in the page hierarchy.
One aperture entry, one structural handoff, and no looping motion.

rules.name: The Three-Role Rule
rules.body: New hues do not enter the page to distinguish books or components. Hierarchy comes from field scale, alpha, typography, and structure.

rules.name: The Instrument Test
rules.body: Zen Kaku Gothic New is reserved for text that helps the reader locate, compare, verify, or act.

rules.name: The Folio Rule
rules.body: A section must behave like a page field, proof ledger, or authored artifact. Do not insert equal-size cards to consume empty space.

rules.name: The Physical-Plane Rule
rules.body: A shadow must answer what is above what. No panel glow, floating card shadow, or ambient halo is permitted.

rules.name: The Square Default Rule
rules.body: Radius is zero unless a future object real material construction requires a curve.

dos: Do let an entire section field carry a volume identity before adding component decoration.
Do keep real counts, source horizons, page ranges, epistemic labels, and paths close to the claim they qualify.
Do preserve one label-roll hover grammar across navigation and actions.
Do rebuild and verify the self-contained standalone after every source change.
donts: Don't turn the folio into a store, testimonial page, summary feed, dashboard, or equal-card catalogue.
Don't copy Stripe Press branding, covers, logos, purchase rows, source markup, or scripts.
Don't introduce generic AI glow, glass, neon, animated wireframes, or synthetic-mind theater.
Don't animate layout properties, translate the outer footer plate, or add a second signature gesture.
